Querying basics, instant vector selectors: in the simplest form only a metric name (e.g. http_requests_total) is given, which returns all time series with that name; label matchers in curly braces filter further.

Functions, rate(): "calculates the per-second average rate of increase of the time series in the range vector. Breaks in monotonicity (such as counter resets due to target restarts) are automatically adjusted for." rate "should only be used with counters". issues.text: Key c is still the only correct option, but its reason is inaccurate: rate over a window that spans the restart also counts the increase before the drop (resets are "adjusted for", not cut off). The lesson itself says rate "keeps counting the increase after it", not that it discards what came before.
issues.fix: Replace option c (en) with: "False, because the fall to near zero is read as the API restarting, not as lost requests, so counting simply goes on from the new low value." and the vi text to match: "Sai, vì cú rơi xuống gần 0 được hiểu là API khởi động lại, không phải request bị mất, nên việc đếm cứ tiếp tục từ giá trị thấp mới."
